title: URL and typosquat spotting
description: Compare lookalike hostnames, punycode, and risky TLDs against the real Northwind and PayPal-style brands used in this lab. All hostnames are simulated.
learningObjectives: Detect digit and character substitutions in brand-like domains
Treat punycode (xn--) as something to decode, not as proof of safety
Flag disposable or unusual TLDs in unsolicited messages
Compare displayed link text to the real hostname
hints: A Latin 'l' and digit '1' are easy to miss at small font sizes.
Punycode is a representation of Unicode domains — decode it before trusting the brand.
